# Shino Jomoto

> Personal website of Shino Jomoto — climber, adventurer, burrito enthusiast.

## About
- [About](https://shinojomoto.com/about.html): Personal facts, humor, and musings. Shino's favorite food is the super burrito. Fervent salad dodger. Biggest regret is not creating a Yelp just for burritos. New year's resolution is always the same: summit a lot of stuff. Confidence is often in direct conflict with reality.

## Climbing
- [Climbing](https://shinojomoto.com/climbing.html): Interactive maps and photo map of climbing adventures around the world — Yosemite, Patagonia, Japan, Croatia, Switzerland, Jordan, Oman, Thailand, and many more locations. Includes trip reports for routes like The Nose, The Salathe, and Astroman on El Capitan.

- Email: shino.jomoto@gmail.com
